original: Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδόν Κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν.
translation: The voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord; make straight the paths of our God.
literal_notes: βοῶντος: present participle, 'of one crying out'
differences_from_web: LXX places 'in the wilderness' with the crying voice (ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ βοῶντος); Hebrew/WEB place 'in the wilderness' with 'prepare the way'
LXX has 'make straight the paths of our God' where WEB has 'make a level highway in the desert for our God'; 'desert' is not in the LXX verse
_web_text: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.
